tools.name: edit_remarks

output_schema.description: Structured result for one persisted authoring mutation.
output_schema.title: StableMutationResult

tools.description: Create, update, remove, or move one report section. For operation=update, depth_range must be an object with numeric minimum and maximum and optional unit, for example {minimum: 25, maximum: 4845, unit: ft}. For operation=add, section must be a complete section object with a non-empty tracks list; to clone an existing section structure, use replicate_section_structure instead.
tools.name: edit_section

output_schema.description: Structured result for one persisted authoring mutation.
output_schema.title: StableMutationResult

tools.description: Copy one existing section's validated track structure to a new section, optionally with bindings and a new source. Use this for multi-section packets instead of synthesizing a section object without tracks. The operation is retry-safe: an equivalent existing target returns a successful no-op with already_exists=true and a stable source-to-target id_map; a conflicting target fails unless overwrite=true.
tools.name: replicate_section_structure

output_schema.description: Structured result for one persisted authoring mutation.
output_schema.title: StableMutationResult

tools.description: Create, update, remove, move, clear, or set scales on one track. section_id and track_id are required for every operation. For operation=add, title, kind, and width_mm must be supplied in the same call; add appends the track, then use operation=move for placement. A retry of an equivalent add is a successful no-op; an add with conflicting properties must use operation=update. Track x_scale is the shared horizontal axis/grid scale for normal and array tracks; curve binding scale is independent content scale. Array raster presentation belongs on edit_raster_binding fields such as profile, colorbar, sample_axis, and color_limits. Use operation=set_scales only when both are intentionally synchronized, or use update with x_scale and edit_curve_binding with scale independently. For update, remove, move, and clear_bindings, track_id must already exist.
tools.name: edit_track

output_schema.description: Structured result for one persisted authoring mutation.
output_schema.title: StableMutationResult
